sections.Profile:
"Criterium 80" is an electro-mechanical pinball machine released by Recel S.A. in 1975. The game accommodates a single player and features two flippers, two pop bumpers, two slingshots, six standup targets, three captive balls, three kick-out holes, and a spinning target.

- Manufacturer: Recel S. A.
- Years made: 1975
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Wedgehead, Racing, Sports, Bikes, 1970s
